title: Battelle Memorial Institute linked to gifted-and-talented programs and the UFO cabal
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Battelle Memorial Institute linked to gifted-and-talented programs and the UFO cabal, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: um a link between Battel Memorial Institute and these gifted and talented education system and the Cabal running these UFO programs

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says an unnamed senior government official told of a link between the Battelle Memorial Institute, a private research organization, and school programs for gifted and talented children. Michels says the same official tied both to a secretive group, which he calls the Cabal, that runs UFO programs. If true, it would suggest the group looks for bright young people early.
